Diablo 4 Warlock Build (Umbral Chains) Lord of Hatred Build Guide
In this Diablo 4 build guide, I'm going to be showing you the Umbral Chains Warlock build for Diablo 4. This is a Warlock build that focuses on using abyss skills to deal massive damage and clearing out mobs quickly. Whether you're making a fresh warlock build or jumping straight into the end game, this build can reliably deal with most enemies of torment 1 and 2, and has the potential to scale quite well into the higher torment tiers once you've obtained better gear and more Paragon points.
